attributes.context: This appears in Section F, “Elimination of Restrictions on Production,” after the provision that no rules, customs, or practices shall be permitted to limit production or increase the time required to do any work.

extraction_text: There shall be no limitation or restriction of the use of machinery, tools or other labor-saving devices supplied by any Individual Employer.

attributes.context: This appears in the list of work that the agreement says Cement Masons shall perform when tools of the Cement Masons' trade are used or required.

extraction_text: Operation of skill saw, chain saw, Laser Screed, Laser Level, Curb and Slipform machines, Epoxy Type Injection pumps, stamps or other means of texturing, any new devices which are beneficial to the construction of or with concrete or related products.
